name: VNB Driver Analysis — BP Tables v4 (clean)
description: Value-new-business planning ontology built from six clean source tables (product master, agent master, agent-monthly activity, product mix, channel-monthly performance and company totals). The ontology encodes the VNB identity ladder and the joins that connect agent behaviour to channel and company results.
narrative: VNB is produced by active agents selling a product mix at a weighted margin. Every movement can be traced from the company total down to a channel, a product or an agent cohort.

entities.description: A calendar month (YYYY-MM) used by every monthly table.
Agency, Banca or Brokerage — sells and produces APE / VNB.
A licensed seller with a certification level, a churn-risk band and a productivity index.
An insurance product with its own VNB margin, commission and expense load.
Share of a channel's sales carried by each product in a month.
Per-agent monthly status, productivity and APE.

attributes.description: Derived by the ontology as VNB ÷ APE for the channel-month.

relations.description: Agent master rows carry the channel the agent belongs to.
Monthly status / productivity / APE per agent.
Monthly share of the channel's sales by product.

relations.label_en: Mix line refers to a product
relations.description: Each mix line points at one product and its VNB margin.
Channel-monthly rows are one row per period × channel.
Agent-monthly rows are one row per period × agent.

graph_nodes.label: VNB ($M)
graph_nodes.description: Value of new business — the headline planning metric.

graph_nodes.label: APE ($M)
graph_nodes.description: Annualised premium equivalent in force for new business.

graph_nodes.label: VNB margin
graph_nodes.description: VNB ÷ APE; the blended profitability of new business.

graph_nodes.label: Active agents
graph_nodes.description: Agents that sold in the month.

graph_edges.label: volume × productivity × margin
graph_edges.description: VNB = active agents × avg productivity × VNB margin, per channel.

question_rules.patterns: ["what months|which months|month[s]? (are|is) available|data coverage|date range|what periods|how many months"]
question_rules.template:
**Data coverage — {{ vnb_monthly|length }} monthly periods.**
The active ontology covers **{{ month_label(vnb_monthly[0].month) }} to {{ month_label(vnb_monthly[-1].month) }}** ({{ vnb_monthly|length }} months). Company totals are built from {{ channel_monthly|length }} channel-month rows, {{ agent_monthly|length }} agent-month rows for {{ agent_master|length }} agents, and {{ mix|length }} product-mix rows over {{ product|length }} products.

| Month | Total APE | Total VNB | VNB margin |
|---|---|---|---|
{% for r in vnb_monthly %}| {{ month_label(r.month) }} | {{ r.total_ape|money }} | {{ r.total_vnb|money }} | {{ r.total_margin|pct }} |
{% endfor %}
*Reconciliation:* the three channel rows of each month sum to the company total (checked in every period).

tables.label: Product Master
tables.description: One row per product with its VNB margin and loadings.

tables.label: Agent Master
tables.description: Agent roster: channel, join date, certification, churn risk band, productivity index.

tables.label: Agent Monthly Activity
tables.description: Per-agent monthly status, productivity ($k) and APE ($M).

tables.label: Product Mix Monthly
tables.description: Monthly share of each channel's APE by product.

tables.label: Channel Monthly
tables.description: Monthly channel performance: agents, productivity, APE, VNB and derived margin.

tables.label: VNB Monthly (company)
tables.description: Company-level monthly totals: APE, VNB and VNB margin.
